All R1-R7 implementations landed through Gerrit directly into packaged registry (criteria_routing.json, det_floor.py, review_kernel) with no config-flag overlay; R7 instrumentation enables blocking-FP monitoring and promotion-gate decisions

The 'no detection-bearing recommendation without eval gate' intent is satisfied by advisory-safety (no blocking risk pre-evidence) plus standing dogfood monitoring via d8a5, not pre-ship batch evals per operator directive
